answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the bridge of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the inlet re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. By the island of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
